data.message: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to opt in individually—not an all-or-nothing deal. Switching 10→18 earns $8,000 extra if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k; remaining=250−8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500−16k (25%). Even all 25 leave 50, but recovery isn't guaranteed; long-run income may fall. Intentions aren't binding; other catches need recalculation. Please state your exact intended catch and any conditions; 18 is welcome even if others choose 10.
